title: Syrian Chicken Shawarma Wrap
description: A flavorful and spicy chicken shawarma wrap filled with juicy chicken, crunchy vegetables, and creamy tzatziki sauce, all wrapped in a warm pita bread.

ingredients.name: Middle Eastern spice blend (sumac, cumin, coriander, paprika)

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the Middle Eastern spice blend, lemon juice, and olive oil to make the marinade.
Add the chicken to the marinade and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.
Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Remove the chicken from the marinade and grill for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Let the chicken rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
Warm the pita bread by wrapping it in foil and heating it in the oven for a few minutes.
Assemble the shawarma by slicing the chicken and placing it in the pita bread with the chopped onion, cucumber, tomato, and tzatziki sauce.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve immediately.
